negative_evidence.detail: git clone failed with: Could not resolve host: github.com

Initial source treated transition_id presence alone as idempotent. Static falsifier review showed a mutated payload could reuse an old transition_id. Source was hardened to bind each applied transition_id to a SHA-256 payload fingerprint and reject mismatches.

counterhypothesis: A correct in-memory lineage state machine does not prove that live executors, UnifiedDB writers, telemetry collectors, delivery lifecycle or EffectGate persist and re-enter the same identities. Integration can still lose fields, reuse stale generations, or misclassify transport success as completion.
